prompts.name: backpack
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium ecommerce product photography for ShopFront course project. Make one square photorealistic studio photograph of a dark navy everyday backpack with a padded shape, subtle textured woven fabric, black straps, clean zipper hardware. Entire backpack visible, standing upright, three-quarter view, centered with ample breathing room, product fills about 68% of square. Seamless warm stone beige backdrop and floor, soft diffused window light from upper left, natural soft shadow, refined contemporary retail art direction. No brand, no text, no labels, no logos, no extra props, no collage. 1024 by 1024 composition.
